# Documentation register

<!-- Generated by docs/tools/docs_check.py --write from doc-register.json. Edit the JSON, not this file. -->

Every Markdown file in the repository, classified by the first matching rule in `doc-register.json`. The check fails when a new Markdown file matches no rule, so new documents must be classified when they are added. Historical files are never moved or rewritten: links, test comments and evidence manifests refer to them by path.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| current | Maintained; the authority for its subject. Update it in the same pull request as the change it describes. |
| generated | Produced by a script from a data file; edit the source and regenerate. |
| reference | Still-valid explanation or method. Status and count claims inside it may be dated; current status lives in the master plan backlog. |
| historical | A dated plan, review or status note kept for traceability. Its open items are carried by the lineage register (document 12). |
| superseded | Replaced by the listed successor. Kept because other files, tests or evidence cite it by path. |
| evidence | A retained measurement, run record or checkpoint. It certifies only the inputs it names. |
